required_evidence: Retained official GIS evidence for the individual pair
Direct official legal boundary evidence linking the historical division to the 2026 ward
exact.acceptance_threshold: One-to-one relationship with mutual GIS overlap at or above 99.999%, no material split or merge, and direct legal evidence.

required_evidence: Retained official GIS evidence for the individual pair
Direct official legal boundary evidence linking the historical division to the 2026 ward
Manual justification explaining the remaining boundary difference
near_exact.acceptance_threshold: One-to-one relationship with mutual GIS overlap at or above 95%, no material split or merge, direct legal evidence, and documented manual justification.

split.rejection_reason: A historical division overlaps multiple material 2026 wards and cannot be represented as one-to-one.
split.acceptance_threshold: No one-to-one mapping may be accepted. Any future aggregate relationship requires a separately approved methodology and direct evidence.

merged.rejection_reason: A 2026 ward overlaps multiple material historical divisions and cannot be represented as one-to-one.
merged.acceptance_threshold: No one-to-one mapping may be accepted. Any future aggregate relationship requires a separately approved methodology and direct evidence.

uncertain.rejection_reason: GIS evidence does not establish a comparable one-to-one geography.
uncertain.acceptance_threshold: Remain unresolved unless new direct official boundary evidence and a documented review establish comparability.

current_evidence_assessment.reason: The reviewed 2026 legal source defines the 2026 wards and their relationship to 2024 electoral divisions, but does not provide an individual historical-division-to-2026-ward crosswalk.

prohibited_actions: Do not calculate vote change from unresolved mappings.
Do not calculate incumbency from unresolved mappings.
Do not calculate candidate history from unresolved mappings.
Do not convert a GIS overlap into a final Geographic Mapping row automatically.
